title: The Frogs Complaining Against the Sun
summary: When the Sun announced his marriage, mortals celebrated, but the frogs in the marsh began croaking in mournful protest....
full_text:
When the Sun announced his marriage, mortals celebrated, but the frogs in the marsh began croaking in mournful protest.

Asked why they lamented, an old frog answered: "One sun alone dries up our pools and bakes our marshes into dust; if he marries and begets sons, all the waters on earth will vanish and we shall perish!"
moral: Beware lest the marriage of one tyrant multiplies your oppressors tenfold.
